status: Retrospective; previous H/N outcomes and baseline aggregate results have been observed. Not a fresh protein validation.
hypothesis: The minimum distance from mutation-site side-chain heavy atoms to each observed backbone N atom ranks H/N chemical-shift perturbations better than CA-to-CA distance.
source_structure: 6BTA chain A only; highest-occupancy atom selection; no target structure input

candidate_scores.sidechain_amide_distance: negative minimum Euclidean distance from source site97 sidechain heavy atoms to observed residue backbone N
candidate_scores.sidechain_ca_distance: negative minimum distance from source site97 sidechain heavy atoms to observed residue CA; secondary control
candidate_scores.all_heavy_distance: negative minimum distance between source site97 sidechain heavy atoms and observed residue heavy atoms; secondary control
candidate_scores.contact_diffusion: CA contact graph at 8 Angstrom; row-normalized random walk with restart 0.5 at site97, stationary visit mass; secondary network baseline

primary_exclusion: exclude sequence positions95-99; identical matched sites across every score
sensitivities: all matched sites and exclusion92-102; H-only and N-only rankings
primary_metric: Spearman vs original sqrt(dH^2+(dN/5)^2), temperatures283K and298K separate
success_statement: A point improvement requires higher Spearman than original CA baseline at BOTH temperatures. Any uncertainty interval is descriptive on one correlated protein. No population-level improvement guarantee.
secondary_metrics: original top-quarter precision, deterministic residue-index ties
uncertainty: 2000 paired circular sequence-block bootstrap draws, block length10, seed20261110; intervals descriptive only
additional_observable: Unanalyzed source-deposit CA/CB shifts at298K: sqrt(dCA^2+dCB^2), positions with both atoms and original exclusions, secondary only; no selection based on this target
no_tuning: No fitted weights, architecture search, cutoff sweeps or changed exclusion based on scores. Publish all candidates and targets. If primary fails, keep failure.
novelty: Atom distances and contact-network propagation are established ideas. This is a small evaluation, not a novel mechanism or algorithm. No additional model downloads.
publication: Full results pushed privately; clean public review export authorized by user. No private conversations, personal application data, employer material or model weights in public export.
